sum: Exelon Corporation, a utility services holding company, engages in the energy distribution and transmission businesses in the United States. The company is involved in the purchase and regulated retail sale of electricity and natural gas; transmission and distribution of electricity; and distribution of natural gas to retail customers. It serves residential, commercial, industrial, and public authorities and electric railroads customers. Exelon Corporation was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.
ceo: Mr. Calvin G. Butler Jr. (CEO, President & Director)

The Annual Meeting of Shareholders (the “Annual Meeting”) of Exelon Corporation (“Exelon” or the “Company”) was held on April 28, 2026. Shareholders of record as of March 2, 2026, were entitled to receive notice and vote at the Annual Meeting.
